annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Information Technology Laboratory
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds AI-model-specific recommendations, considerations and notes to SSDF 1.1 practices and tasks as a Community Profile.
Protect training data, model weights and configuration parameters from unauthorized access and tampering (least privilege, hashes, signatures).
Verify provenance and integrity of training data and acquired models; scan and test models for malware, backdoors and vulnerabilities.
Include AI-specific threats such as data poisoning and prompt injection in risk modeling, with red teaming and adversarial testing.
Deployment and operation of AI systems and broader data governance are out of scope; use is risk-based, not a checklist.
annotation.summary_en: NIST SP 800-218A is an SSDF Community Profile, issued under Executive Order 14110, that augments SSDF 1.1 with AI-model-specific secure development recommendations for generative AI and dual-use foundation models. It guides model producers, system producers and acquirers on protecting data, weights and pipelines using a voluntary, risk-based approach.
annotation.title_clean: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile
annotation.title_en: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile
